editorial.blurb: This late-night Chicago taqueria serves up authentic, flavor-packed tacos with fresh meat and house-made tortillas that keep locals and visitors coming back night after night.
editorial.insiderTip: Go late night for the real street-food energy and order the birria tacos immediately—they disappear fast. Ask the staff to explain dishes if you're new to the menu; they're genuinely helpful.

topDishes.note: Meat-packed and gone in minutes; the defining dish that keeps people returning
Described as the best reviewers have ever had
Juicy, tender meat that practically melts in your mouth
